title: Neoadjuvant chemo-immunotherapy for stage III PD-L1 positive Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
official: Neoadjuvant chemo-immunotherapy for stage III PD-L1 positive Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the rate of radical surgery (R0) in patients with stage III PD-L1 positive NSCLC treated with tislelizumab plus platinum-based doublet chemotherapy as neoadjuvant treatment
conditions: stage III PD-L1 positive Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)
Lung cancer non-small cell stage III

interventions.name: Tevimbra 100 mg concentrate for solution for infusion
Cisplatino Hikma 1mg/ml concentrato per soluzione per infusione
Pemetrexed Ever Pharma 25 mg/ml concentrato per soluzione per infusione
Carboplatino Hikma 10 mg/ml soluzione per infusione
Paclitaxel Accord Healthcare Italia 6 mg/ml, concentrato per soluzione per infusione

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Histologically confirmed stage III disease.
2. Age ≥ 18 years.
3. Written informed consent
4. PD-L1 TPS ≥ 1% according to local testing.
5. No evidence of EGFR mutations or ALK or ROS1 or RET rearrangements by local testing.
6. Mandatory baseline multidisciplinary assessment to confirm suitability of patient to local treatment with curative intent.
7. Pulmonary function tests within 6 months of the planned resection.
8. At least 1 measurable lesion as defined by RECIST v1.1.
9. ECOG Performance Status ≤ 1.
10. Eligibility to receive a platinum doublet chemotherapy regimen.
11. Adequate organ function as indicated by the following laboratory values obtained ≤ 14 days before the first dose of study drug
Exclusion criteria:
1. Evidence of stage IV NSCLC (metastatic disease).
2. Histology of large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma (LCNEC).
3. Any previous therapy for current lung cancer, including chemotherapy or radiation therapy
4. Previous treatment with an antibody or drug against the immune checkpoint pathway, including but not limited to, therapeutic anti-cytotoxic T-lymphocyte antigen-4-associated antibodies (anti-CTLA-4), anti-PD-1 and anti-PD-L1.
5. Never smoking patients.
6. Active autoimmune diseases or history of autoimmune diseases that may recur
7. Concomitant participation in another therapeutic clinical trial.
8. Pregnancy or breastfeeding.
